(613)

This means that each Cartesian component of the gravitational field satisfies an independent wave equation with a source. This allows us to write a Green function for the scalar equation and obtain a Green function for the tensorial equation in Cartesian components.

For the scalar wave equation, we know that a solution to

\opbraces{\square^{2}}G_{R}(x,y)=\delta^{(4)}(x,y)

(614)

in Minkowski spacetime is given by

G_{R}(x,y)=-\frac{\delta(\mathchoice{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\mathchoice{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}})}{4\pi\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}}}\Theta(\mathchoice{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\mathchoice{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}),

(615)

with
\Theta
standing for the Heaviside step function. This is known as the retarded Green function and it has the property that
G_{R}(x,y)
vanishes for
x
outside the future lightcone of
y
. This topic is well-discussed in books on electrodynamics
[
158
,
238
,
253
]
.

In terms of the Green function, we can write the solution to the linearized Einstein equations in Cartesian coordinates as

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}(x)

\displaystyle=-16\pi\int G_{R}(x,y)\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}(y)\differential[4]{y},

(616a)

\displaystyle=4\int\frac{\delta(\mathchoice{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\mathchoice{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}})\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}(y)}{\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}}}\Theta(\mathchoice{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{x^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}-\mathchoice{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}}{y^{{{0}}}_{{\mathchoice{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[3.98613pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[2.45pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[1.75pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}})\differential[4]{y},

(616b)

\displaystyle=4\int\frac{\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}\quantity(\tensor{x}{^0} - \norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}}, \vb{y})}{\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}}}\differential[3]{y}.

(616c)

If the only approximation we were interested in was the linear approximation, we could stop here. Nevertheless, throughout the main text we will be mainly interested in the behavior near infinity, which means we can make a large
r=\norm{\vb{x}}
approximation. With this in mind, write
\vec{\boldsymbol{x}}=r\boldsymbol{\hat{x}}
and notice that

\displaystyle\norm{\vb{x} - \vb{y}}

\displaystyle=r\norm{\vu{x} - \frac{\vb{y}}{r}},

(617a)

\displaystyle=r\sqrt{1-\frac{2\boldsymbol{\hat{x}}\dotproduct\vec{\boldsymbol{y}}}{r}+\frac{\norm{\vb{y}}^{2}}{r^{2}}},

(617b)

\displaystyle=r-\boldsymbol{\hat{x}}\dotproduct\vec{\boldsymbol{y}}+\order{\frac{1}{r}}.

(617c)

Using this in
Eq.

616
leads to

\mathchoice{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{\bar{h}^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}(t,\vec{\boldsymbol{x}})=\frac{4}{r}\int\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scri - r + \vu{x} \vdot\vb{y}, \vb{y})\differential[3]{y}+\order{\frac{1}{r^2}}.

(618)

Notice the approximation requires
r
to be large when compared to the region in which the stress tensor is non-vanishing.

To proceed from this point, we follow the same techniques used in multipole expansions in electrodynamics. More specifically, I will adapt the discussions in Section 5.3 of Ref.
\citeonline
wald2022AdvancedClassicalElectromagnetism. Let us rewrite the stress tensor in a Taylor series, which will allow us to get rid of the angular dependency. We write

\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}\quantity(t - r + \vu{x} \vdot\vb{y}, \vb{y})=\sum_{n=0}^{+\infty}\frac{1}{n!}\partialderivative[n]{t}\mathchoice{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}{T^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\mu}{\nu}}}}\quantity(t-r, \vb{y})\quantity(\vu{x} \vdot\vb{y})^{n}.

(619)

Appendix D
Preserving the Strong Carrollian Structure

In this appendix, I show how preserving the strong Carrollian structure can affect the
\gls
BMS group. For simplicity, we will from the start ignore the contributions due to Lorentz transformations, since we are interested in knowing whether preserving the strong Carrollian structure is enough to get rid of the supertranslations. This considerably simplifies the calculations, but will still allow us to conclude that the strong Carrollian structure is too strong to define asymptotic symmetry groups. This is due to the fact that, as we shall see, we end up losing the spatial translations with this definition.

Since we are working with only supertranslations, we are working from the start with isometries (not confomorphisms) that preserve the strong conformal geometry. Hence, we have that the vector fields

\displaystyle=-\frac{2\bar{\zeta}}{1+\zeta\bar{\zeta}}\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}f,

\displaystyle=-\frac{2\zeta}{1+\zeta\bar{\zeta}}\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}f,

(636b)

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}f

\displaystyle=0,

(636c)

\displaystyle\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}f

\displaystyle=0.

(636d)

Denote
f_{\zeta}=\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}f
and
f_{\bar{\zeta}}=\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}f
. Then
Eq.

636d
tells us that
f_{\zeta}
is a holomorphic function of
\zeta
, and, equivalently, bears no dependence on
\bar{\zeta}
. Thus, the
\gls
LHS of
Eq.

636a
does not depend on
\bar{\zeta}
, but the
\gls
RHS may. This is only possible if both of them vanish. Hence,
f_{\zeta}=0
. Similarly,
f_{\bar{\zeta}}=0
. We thus get to the system of differential equations

\left\{\begin{aligned} &\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.25pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[3.67499pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[2.625pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\zeta}}}}f=0,\\
&\mathchoice{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}{\partial^{{\mathchoice{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\displaystyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\textstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptstyle$}}{\makebox[5.00002pt][c]{$\scriptscriptstyle$}}}}_{{{\bar{\zeta}}}}}f=0,\end{aligned}\right.

(637)

which is solved by constant
f
.

Therefore, imposing the preservation of the strong Carrollian structure imposes that the function
f
is a constant. On the one hand, this does rule out the supertranslations. On the other hand, it also rules out spatial translations. We thus conclude the preservation of strong Carrollian structure is too strong to be imposed on the asymptotic symmetry group.

Appendix E
Stationary Phase Approximation in the Sphere

In some points throughout the text we need to compute a few integrals on the sphere at infinity. These integrals typically have the form

\int_{\mathbb{S}^{2}}G(\theta,\phi)e^{-i\omega r(1-\cos\theta)}\sin\theta\differential{\theta}\differential{\phi}

(638)

for large
r
.

These sorts of integrals can be approximated to leading order in
r
by employing the stationary phase approximation (see, for example, Theorem 7.7.5 in Ref.
\citeonline
hormander2003DistributionTheoryFourier for a particular case). For an integral over a finite open set
U\subseteq\mathbb{R}^{n}
, we would have (for large
r
)

\int_{U}F(\vec{\boldsymbol{x}})e^{irf(\vec{\boldsymbol{x}})}\differential[n]{x}=\sum_{\vec{\boldsymbol{x}}_{0}\in\Sigma}e^{irf(\vec{\boldsymbol{x}}_{0})}\quantity[\det(\frac{r f''(\vb{x}_0)}{2 \pi i})]^{-\frac{1}{2}}F(\vec{\boldsymbol{x}}_{0})+o\quantity(\frac{1}{r^{\frac{n}{2}}}),

(639)

where
f^{\prime\prime}
denotes the Hessian of
f
and
\Sigma\subseteq U
is the collection of points with
\differential{f}|_{\vec{\boldsymbol{x}}_{0}}=0
—
i.e.
, the collections of points in which the phase is stationary. Above, we assume
F
and
f
to be real functions and for the Hessian of
f
to be nonvanishing at
\Sigma
, among other technical conditions on which we will not focus.

The key difficulty in
Eq.

638
is the fact that the phase is stationary precisely when its Hessian vanishes, which violates the assumption on the behavior of the Hessian of
f
. Hence, the stationary phase approximation becomes problematic.

To circumvent this issue, we compute the integral in real stereographic coordinates. Define the (real) coordinates
X
and
Y
on the sphere by

X=\cot\frac{\theta}{2}\cos\phi\quad\mbox{and}\quad Y=\cot\frac{\theta}{2}\sin\phi,

(640)

which are just the real and imaginary parts of the complex stereographic coordinate of
Eq.

65
. These coordinates hold for
\theta<\pi
. Define also

\tilde{X}=-\tan\frac{\theta}{2}\cos\phi\quad\mbox{and}\quad\tilde{Y}=-\tan\frac{\theta}{2}\sin\phi,

(641)

which are just the real and imaginary parts of the complex stereographic coordinate of
Eq.

74
. These coordinates hold for
\theta>0
. We now find that (in the domains in which the expressions make sense)

1-\cos\theta=\frac{2}{1+X^{2}+Y^{2}}=2-\frac{2}{1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2}},

(642)

and

\sin\theta\differential{\theta}\differential{\phi}=\frac{4\differential{X}\differential{Y}}{(1+X^{2}+Y^{2})^{2}}=\frac{4\differential{\tilde{X}}\differential{\tilde{Y}}}{(1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2})^{2}}.

(643)

and the metric and volume element expressed in terms of them have the same form as for
(X,Y)
.

Therefore, we found

\int_{\mathbb{S}^{2}}G(\theta,\phi)e^{-i\omega r(1-\cos\theta)}\sin\theta\differential{\theta}\differential{\phi}=\int_{X^{2}+Y^{2}\leq 1}G(X,Y)e^{-\frac{2i\omega r}{1+X^{2}+Y^{2}}}\frac{4\differential{X}\differential{Y}}{(1+X^{2}+Y^{2})^{2}}\\
+\int_{\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2}<1}G(\tilde{X},\tilde{Y})e^{\frac{2i\omega r}{1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2}}-2i\omega r}\frac{4\differential{\tilde{X}}\differential{\tilde{Y}}}{(1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2})^{2}}.

(644)

Both integrals run over finite sets. This ensures we will not run into problems with a stationary point at infinity.

Notice that

\differential\quantity(\frac{1}{1 + X^2 + Y^2})=-\frac{2X\differential{X}}{1+X^{2}+Y^{2}}-\frac{2Y\differential{Y}}{1+X^{2}+Y^{2}},

(645)

which vanishes at the origin
46
46

46

And would vanish at infinity if we had not restricted the integrals to the unit circle
. The stationary phase approximation yields

\int_{X^{2}+Y^{2}\leq 1}G(X,Y)e^{-\frac{2i\omega r}{1+X^{2}+Y^{2}}}\frac{4\differential{X}\differential{Y}}{(1+X^{2}+Y^{2})^{2}}=-\frac{2i\pi e^{-2i\omega r}}{r\omega}G(\theta=\pi)+o\quantity(\frac{1}{r})

(646)

and

\int_{\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2}<1}G(\tilde{X},\tilde{Y})e^{\frac{2i\omega r}{1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2}}-2i\omega r}\frac{4\differential{\tilde{X}}\differential{\tilde{Y}}}{(1+\tilde{X}^{2}+\tilde{Y}^{2})^{2}}=-\frac{2i\pi}{r\omega}G(\theta=0)+o\quantity(\frac{1}{r}).

(647)

Hence, we find that

\int_{\mathbb{S}^{2}}G(\theta,\phi)e^{-i\omega r(1-\cos\theta)}\sin\theta\differential{\theta}\differential{\phi}=-\frac{2i\pi}{r\omega}G(\theta=0)-\frac{2i\pi e^{-2i\omega r}}{r\omega}G(\theta=\pi)+o\quantity(\frac{1}{r}).

(648)

With a minor change of notation we find

\int_{\mathbb{S}^{2}}G(\boldsymbol{\hat{q}})e^{-i\omega r(1-\boldsymbol{\hat{q}}\dotproduct\boldsymbol{\hat{x}})}\sqrt{\gamma(\boldsymbol{\hat{q}})}\differential[2]{q}=-\frac{2i\pi}{r\omega}G(\boldsymbol{\hat{x}})-\frac{2i\pi e^{-2i\omega r}}{r\omega}G(-\boldsymbol{\hat{x}})+o\quantity(\frac{1}{r}),

(649)

where
\gamma(\boldsymbol{\hat{q}})
denotes the metric determinant as a function of the unit vector
\boldsymbol{\hat{q}}
.
